title: Crops
info: Rice is the main food crop. Aman, aus, and boro are important rice seasons.
Jute is a fiber crop Bangladesh became famous for. It is used to make sacks, rope, and cloth.
Tea grows in the hills around Sylhet. Mango orchards are famous in the northwest.
